description: This file is a shell script for testing various aspects of 'git commit' behavior within a Git project's test suite. It includes functions, test cases, and setup code to verify functionalities such as commit message cleanup, trailers, editors invocation, conflicts, and various command options.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Compares the latest commit message with an expected message file.

methods.name: check_summary_oneline
methods.description: Creates git commits with specific parameters and verifies their summary output.

methods.name: trailer_commit_base
methods.description: Creates a commit with trailers for testing trailer inclusion in commit messages.

methods.name: output_tests_cleanup
methods.description: Resets the repository state to clean up after tests, mainly for merge conflict tests.

methods.name: try_commit
methods.description: Attempts to create a commit with optional template and checks if the commit message includes certain content.

methods.name: try_commit_status_combo
methods.description: Runs a series of test cases on commits with different status options and configurations.
